description: This file implements the MediaEngineRMF plugin for WPEFramework, providing media playback control via JSON-RPC methods. It manages media player initialization, playback, volume, mute, and video rectangle settings, and handles related events and errors.

classes.name: MediaEngineRMF
classes.description: Main class implementing the media engine plugin, managing state, media player object, and handling JSON-RPC methods and events.

methods.name: initialize_player
methods.description: Initializes media support for 'qam' source type, including setting environment variables and calling mediaplayer::initialize.

methods.name: deinitialize_player
methods.description: Deinitializes media support for 'qam' source type, calling mediaplayer::deinitialize.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Creates and starts media playback for a specified 'qam' source with OCAP locator.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback and cleans up media player object.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Sets mute state of the media player.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for media playback.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Configures the video rectangle position and size for display.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Handles media player events and sends notifications.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors from media player and sends error notifications.
